provenance.description: Original project-authored synthetic emergency sound candidates. No recordings, sound libraries, external UGens, Quarks or musical material.
provenance.runtime: Authoring only; generated WAV files are the integration boundary. SuperCollider is not bundled with the game.
provenance.rights: No third-party sample attribution or sample-library redistribution restriction applies. Source and generated audio follow the project's ownership/release policy; SuperCollider's own software license remains with the authoring tool.
provenance.status: Offline auditions; current human preferences are recorded in selections.json. Not imported into Unreal. These are designed game identities, not regional emergency-signal standards.

candidates.label: A · brisk rounded yelp
candidates.intent: Quick, clear upward/downward sweeps with restrained upper harmonics.

candidates.label: B · sharper rising yelp
candidates.intent: More urgent rising sweeps with a softened reset and brighter harmonic bite.

candidates.label: A · broad engine wail
candidates.intent: Slower, lower, weightier sweeping siren, distinct from the police yelp.

candidates.label: B · wail with intermittent horn
candidates.intent: Broad sweeping siren with a short low air-horn-like accent; review whether the accent is too distracting.

candidates.label: A · rounded two-tone
candidates.intent: Alternating held notes with smooth transitions and a less abrasive timbre.

candidates.label: B · quicker bright two-tone
candidates.intent: Faster held-note alternation with more definition; compare recognizability and fatigue with A.

candidates.label: A · low mechanical warning
candidates.intent: Slow low sweep, beating harmonics and rotor modulation to move away from D57's vehicle-like alarm.

candidates.label: B · heavier civil-warning rise
candidates.intent: Lower, darker rising cycle with stronger rotor texture; compare the cycle reset with A's continuous wail.
